profile.headline: Apache Member and PMC member of Apache {Hadoop, Spark, Storm, Tez} at NVIDIA
profile.summary:
I write code and design distributed systems. Most of it is open source. Feel free to take a look

https://github.com/revans2
https://issues.apache.org/jira/issues/?jql=assignee%20in%20(revans2)

positions.title: Distinguished  Distributed  System  Software  Engineer
positions.description: Crazy fast data processing on GPUs in open source.

positions.title: Apache Storm PMC
positions.description: I am a committer and Project Management Committee (PMC) member of the Apache Storm project.

positions.title: Apache Hadoop PMC
positions.description: I am a committer and Project Management Committee (PMC) member for the Apache Hadoop project.  PMC member since September 2012.

positions.title: Senior Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Just like at Yahoo! I run a team in charge of several open source projects for  not just all of Oath but also Verizon.  Apache Storm, Apache Zookeeper, Apache Bookkeeper, and Apache Kafka.

I am also a member of the senior tech council setting the direction for technology at all of Oath.

positions.title: Software Architect
positions.description:
Storm stream processing Development.

Hadoop Map/Reduce YARN, and HDFS Development.

Development of machine learning software on Hadoop. (August 2007 - December 2010)

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Porting, development, and maintenance of the GNU Linux operating system on
ARM processors for use on next generation cell phones.

Design and maintenance of a 3GPP 27.007, 3GPP 27.005, and Bluetooth HFP
1.5 compatible AT Command interpreter for GNU Linux based cell phones.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
Design of a fast prototyping system for hand-held/embedded devices. This
included research into the electronic components for the project and some of the
systems level design. I also automated much of the design process to allow
others to easily expand and maintain the system.
